catalogue.display_name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next · Huihui abliterated · UD-Q4_K_XL
catalogue.about: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is a text and image model by Alibaba Qwen. Huihui made this abliterated version, which reduces refusal behavior. Unsloth’s UD-Q4_K_XL stores weights at mixed precision, mostly 4-bit, to reduce memory use. This is Bubo’s default model.

licence.name: Qwen Community License 1.0
licence.prompt_line: License: Qwen Community License 1.0. It is not MIT. Prepare shows the full text before it downloads.

speed.source: Bubo release measurements: decode = mean of 6 greedy probes; prefill = 8K natural-text prompt, median of 3
speed.label: measured on Strix Halo 128 GB, smoke-grade

estimate.evidence_label: estimated from the measured Flash Next coefficient
notes: Only artefacts selected by the resolved release profile are counted.
Cache mode and allowance follow serve's resolved release settings. Cache ceilings do not allocate storage at startup; on-demand snapshot growth is excluded from both startup estimates.

memory_estimate.reason: Conservative startup estimate. The configured cache retention ceiling is not allocated at startup; on-demand cache and snapshot growth are not included. Full-context retention is not verified.

reference_coefficient.conditions: Executor only, one 262144-token session; vision is a separate term.

catalogue.about: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is a text and image model by Alibaba Qwen. This is the original version, without abliteration. Unsloth’s UD-Q4_K_XL stores weights at mixed precision, mostly 4-bit, to reduce memory use. It is offered for people who prefer the original model’s behavior.
